lean.fidelity_note: For the fixed profiles, the formal statement retains the expansion, divergence and residual identities, support and preactivation vanishing, the final-level convention, and phase independence of the remainder outside the envelope. It makes the finite construction's existence and uniqueness explicit and also asserts existence of the seed; uniqueness concerns exactly the levels used in the construction. Its parent pressure assumptions are broader than §5.1, and it permits any nonzero central seed with $\gamma\le1$, so the paper's normalization is included. The radius threshold is uniform in the parent and expansion depth.
